dataflow.scope: Existing attempt_spend: matching physical solver requests; archived attempts included, reused prefix records excluded. Reserve is uncertainty, never added to reported known cost. Replay/setup wall time is not solver cost.

smolagents-shared.scope: All matching physical solver turn records, including archived failed/partial attempts; reused records excluded. No replay/setup timings or budget reserve added to cost.

physical_judge_cost.policy: Deduplicate raw provider response IDs globally; cache originals and copied judge.json are the same request. Failed-response artifacts included. No solver/replay spend included.

paired_response_cost_sensitivity.policy: Main solver costs retain all native $1.26991388 and baseline $1.21611724; the main official score denominator remains 185 for both arms. Conditional sensitivities remove exactly the same specified question IDs from both arms, keeping every other actual recorded turn. No session is rerun or reconstructed; removed histories/errors may still affect later observed costs.

metrics_policy.cost_policy: Frozen gateway token-rate estimates, not invoices. Known sums retain explicit coverage; physical and completed costs separate.
metrics_policy.state_policy: Accepted receipt operations only. No observer-based state-match comparison with stock smolagents. Literal-setting and branch counts are syntactic diagnostics, not semantic correctness.
metrics_policy.accuracy_policy: Correct/185 is provisional until all185 judgments exist. Unknown judges are explicit; official judgments unchanged.
metrics_policy.cascade_policy: Runtime blocked descendants counted mechanically; semantic cascading failures require a separate raw-trace audit, never inferred from a prior failed answer.
